g.text: VCM_REF is the common baseline of every AC-coupled stage downstream of the OPA857: the return of the post-amp input coupling (Front End), the OPA855 gain reference, and

g.text: RSSI is a slow, RELATIVE received-light indicator for the ESP32 (read by the ADS1115) to trim APD bias (DAC_HV) and the OPA857 20k/5k gain. It is not calibrated: the

g.desc: RSSI is a slow, RELATIVE received-light indicator for the ESP32 (read by the ADS1115) to trim APD bias (DAC_HV) and the OPA857 20k/5k gain. It is not calibrated: the

g.text: BAS70 forward drop and the 1 k tap resistor on the Front End (R58) shift it; the ESP32 calibrates against the FPGA's 8b/10b validity.

g.desc: BAS70 forward drop and the 1 k tap resistor on the Front End (R58) shift it; the ESP32 calibrates against the FPGA's 8b/10b validity.

g.text: U30A OPA2320 unity buffer of a 10k/10k divider from 3V3 with C100 100 nF at the midpoint. U30A drives C101 1 uF through R102 10 ohm and VCM_REF is taken after R102.

g.desc: U30A OPA2320 unity buffer of a 10k/10k divider from 3V3 with C100 100 nF at the midpoint. U30A drives C101 1 uF through R102 10 ohm and VCM_REF is taken after R102.

g.text: through D30 and the 1 k tap into the TIA output: about 1.5 mV, negligible. RSSI_HOLD therefore idles at about OUTN + Vf (roughly 1.9 to 2.0 V; Vf at 1.5 uA not looked

g.text: up) and falls as the light rises. TIA_TAP is DC-coupled, so the pull-up cannot saturate anything. U30B buffers RSSI_HOLD to RSSI (unity gain).
